name: Louis Gerard
features: fair skin, dark hair thinning at the crown, dark eyes, long face, heavy nose, spare build, watchful patient expression
bio: Louis Gustave Adolphe Gérard came to racing at thirty-eight, having paid for his first car — so the story runs — in one-franc coins out of the slot machines he owned. He won the 1938 Tourist Trophy at Donington in a Delage D6-70 and took second at that year’s Spa 24 Hours in filthy weather. He outlived every rival he ever had, dying at 101 in the year 2000.
